module_summary: I2C slave exposing one 8-bit register: glitch-filtered SCL/SDA feed edge and start/stop detectors driving an FSM that shifts address and data through a shift register.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: I2C slave FSM: idle, address, ack, write and read byte phases.

anchors.name: data_reg
anchors.why: The single register, written over I2C or by data_latch, read out.

anchors.name: shift_reg
anchors.why: Serial shift register for address and data bytes in and out.

anchors.name: bit_count_reg
anchors.why: Counts bits remaining in current address or data byte.

anchors.name: mode_read_reg
anchors.why: Latched R/W bit selecting read or write path after ACK.

anchors.name: start_bit
anchors.why: Start condition detection resetting FSM to address phase.

anchors.name: stop_bit
anchors.why: Stop condition detection returning FSM to idle.

anchors.name: scl_posedge
anchors.why: SCL rising edge strobe sampling SDA bits.

anchors.name: scl_negedge
anchors.why: SCL falling edge strobe updating SDA output.

anchors.name: scl_i_filter_reg
anchors.why: SCL glitch filter shift register; sda filter is its twin.

anchors.name: scl_i_reg
anchors.why: Filtered SCL level used for edge and start/stop detection.

anchors.name: sda_i_reg
anchors.why: Filtered SDA level shifted into shift_reg.

anchors.name: sda_o
anchors.why: SDA output driving ACK and read data bits from sda_o_reg.

anchors.name: sda_i
anchors.why: Raw SDA input sampled into glitch filter.

anchors.name: scl_i
anchors.why: Raw SCL input sampled into glitch filter.

anchors.name: data_latch
anchors.why: Parallel load enable writing data_in into data_reg.

groups.name: I2C slave FSM
groups.description: Sequences address match, ACK, write and read byte phases.

groups.name: Bit shifter
groups.description: Shifts address/data in from SDA and read data out to SDA.

groups.name: Input filter and edge detect
groups.description: Glitch filters SCL/SDA and detects edges plus start/stop conditions.

groups.name: Data register
groups.description: Single 8-bit register shared by I2C and parallel interface.
